redundant_explanations.method: Count later full treatments of active-account eligibility, the Polish shopper threshold and the Irish merchant threshold. Each is repeated across four baseline sections (three excess explanations per rule). The revised callout briefly repeats eligibility as required by the template, and the process references generic threshold routing locally; these are useful local references and are excluded by the preregistered rubric.

measurement_limits: This is an agent assessment of the annotated fixture, not independent human scoring or proof of semantic perfection on larger corpora. Word counts exclude URL syntax and citation labels but still count Mermaid source words.
